comparison.objective: Crank an insulation tester while probing three cable cores and identify the leaking core; candidate performs mechanical screening.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous rotary actuation coordinated with precise probing and instrument interpretation versus pouring and screen agitation.
comparison.success_condition: All cores tested under sufficient crank speed, only the leaking core flagged, probe returned and hands clear; candidate grades recovered media mass and retained washers.
comparison.reason: Diagnostic measurement and hidden-fault identification are unrelated to granular separation.
